scope: One C revision plus quoted includes up to three edges and direct <uapi/linux/...> declarations. Direct/nested/array assignments and typed-endian |= updates require a resolved declaration; a BIT(n) macro is host-valued only when n fits the target width. Wide alias leads require adjacent u8 plus u8[3] and same-order typed siblings. Pointer/call evidence is not proof of hardware consumption. Normal is local to a write site, including explicit zero values.
